_comment: Structured version of the ShootProof questionnaire build sheets (Website Gallery Pics/../Downloads/*.md, 2026-09-17). Used to let the chatbot walk a visitor through their session questionnaire conversationally instead of requiring the ShootProof web form. Order matters within each questionnaire. 'required: true' fields must always be asked; others can be skipped if the visitor is rushed or doesn't want to answer.
intro: A few quick questions to help plan your session — nothing here is required to "get right." The more I know about you and what you're hoping for, the better Julie can plan locations, timing, and shots that feel like you. Should take about 5 minutes.

questions.text: Names and ages of everyone being photographed (include pets!)
Anything I should know about the kids' personalities or what makes them comfortable in front of a camera?
Any nap schedules, meal timing, or other logistics that would help pick the best time of day?
Tell me a little about your family's story — what's going on in this season of life, and what made you want to do a session right now?
What do you most want to walk away with?
options: Images to share on social media
Updated family photos (haven't had any in a while)
A gift for grandparents or family
Documenting a specific milestone (new baby, move, anniversary, etc.)
Just want great photos, no specific plan

questions.text: Is there a specific shot or moment you really want captured?
How would you describe the vibe you're going for?
options: Not sure — open to your suggestion

questions.text: Do you have any inspiration photos or a Pinterest board you'd like to share?
Color photos, black & white, or a mix?
Would you like help planning outfits for everyone?
options: Yes, please send me your outfit guide
Somewhere in between — I could use a few tips
